scope: Retrospective structural coverage review of previously inspected cached native scans. This is not a fresh independent accuracy evaluation. Rejection/abstention is not counted as an accuracy improvement.

method.ring: Published EIR shade and minimum continuous thickness in 72 directions
method.symmetry: Opposite-sector temperature differences from ADT 9.1 cloud sampling
method.pinhole: Measured eye temperature retained; no inferred warming. Three pixels across the narrow axis is a conservative engineering flag, not an operational ADT rule or calibrated confidence.
method.history: Strictly earlier thermal observations from six to 7.5 hours before; different sampling versions are context only.
method.trainedWeights: Unchanged; frozen 8.2.1 fitted feature definition retained
